scope: Chromium browser integration: desktop 1500×1000 and phone viewport 412×915. No native Android, hardware or vessel-reference validation is implied.
checks: Start fuel supply and one-minute stepping deliver gas; displayed mass ledger balances and model assumptions are visible
Source-style Fuel, Bunker and ME IGPR panes preserve scale; all four pumps, two compressors, parallel vaporizer/heater trains and both buffers are inspectable with distinct station arms
Source-tagged isolation gates stop actual pump allocation and an independently opened alternate pump branch transfers fuel from the same mass-conserving inventory
ESD latches every route disabled; reset leaves all equipment stopped and does not restart delivery
Manual mode shows unknown telemetry without simulator or per-buffer leakage; all route actuation and ESD controls are disabled
Real watch-entry saves preserve zero, tiny tagged readings and custom units; manual diagram converts 135 mbar(g) to 0.135 bar(g) without filling unknowns
Open record is read-only; Edit/Cancel/Close preserve the separate new-entry draft, and invalid numeric, UTC, unit and empty snapshots never change saved data
A failed device write retains the saved record and draft; retry saves the original ID/count, re-sorts observation time, adds a tag and keeps a cleared pressure unknown
Actual CSV/JSON files contain corrected observations, zeros, tiny readings, units and multiline notes; duplicate-ID restore is rejected and a valid merge preserves identities
Observations survive reload, older-record pagination remains editable, and notes-only edits preserve tiny values and originally absent units
Phone diagram fits its fixed aspect ratio, zoom and horizontal trackpad/wheel pan work, and record modal inputs/Close/Save/Cancel fit the phone viewport
